pretreatments.description: Granular sludge was boiled at 90 °C for 30 min
The granular sludge was aerated for 24 h using an aquarium pump with an air flow rate of 3 L/min
The pH of the granular sludge was adjusted to 12.0 ± 0.1 with 3 N NaOH and maintained for 24 h
Fifteen g/L of WFO was added to the granular sludge cultures (33 gVS sludge/L saponified WFO solution) and maintained for 24 h
